  "private": true,

  "scripts": {
    "dev": "wxt --port 5555",

    "zip": "wxt zip",

    "compile": "bun run check-types",
    "postinstall": "wxt prepare"

  "dependencies": {
    "react": "^19.2.8",

baselines.package.json:
{
  "name": "crux",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "workspaces": [
    "apps/*",
    "packages/*"
  ],
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "turbo dev",
    "build": "turbo build",
    "check-types": "turbo check-types",
    "dev:web": "turbo -F web dev",
    "dev:docs": "turbo -F docs dev",
    "build:docs": "turbo -F docs build",
    "check:docs": "turbo -F docs check-types",
    "dev:server": "turbo -F server dev",
    "db:push": "turbo -F @crux/db db:push",
    "db:studio": "turbo -F @crux/db db:studio",
    "db:generate": "turbo -F @crux/db db:generate",
    "db:migrate": "turbo -F @crux/db db:migrate",
    "test": "pnpm --filter web test && pnpm --filter server test && pnpm --filter @crux/api test",
    "knip": "knip",
    "knip:production": "knip --production",
    "secrets:scan": "gitleaks git --redact --verbose",
    "secrets:scan:staged": "gitleaks git --pre-commit --redact --staged --verbose"
  },
  "packageManager": "pnpm@10.17.1",
  "pnpm": {
    "overrides": {
      "kysely": "0.28.17"
    }
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "dotenv": "catalog:",
    "zod": "catalog:",
    "@crux/env": "workspace:*"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "typescript": "^6.0.3",
    "@types/node": "catalog:",
    "@crux/config": "workspace:*",
    "vercel": "^54.18.2",
    "turbo": "^2.10.0",
    "knip": "^6.32.0"
  }
}
